# hg auth

**What this page tells you:** every `hg auth` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Prove sign-in and rbac on the control plane.

## Synopsis

```text
hg auth prove [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## `hg auth prove`

```text
hg auth prove [flags]
```

The auth acceptance matrix.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--control-plane` | `<url>` | — | Base URL of the control plane (the exposed Nexus). |
